activity_summary: On the empty stage Phillips played two measures of a minor Italian pavan and stopped. You counted sixteen bars for old Capulet's welcome and for Tybalt knowing a Montague's voice under the mask, and then the bass viol down so the fourteen lines float. Burbage and Nick spoke at half voice, palm to palm, and stopped when the music stopped. Phillips said nobody in the yard will hear the hautboys, and everybody will hear the pilgrims. Nick stayed under the note the whole way. The parts are not out. You did not copy the fourteen lines onto the margin.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the bars and kept the rehearsal to the feast.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Played two measures, set the sixteen, and stopped them at one pass.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Spoke at half voice, palm to palm, and did not get a second time.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Stayed under the note the whole way.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: There. Now nobody in the yard will hear the hautboys, and everybody will hear the pilgrims.

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: I can hold it if I come in under the note, sir.
